title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 130 (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translations by Wikisource contributors. See source-manifest.json for pinned revisions and contributor histories. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Selected paragraphs from one source revision, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected sections 130:2–5 and 130:7. Section 2 omits Rema glosses and is marked partial. Other sections remain withheld; section 6 describes the Hebrew categories of people as forgers, which is not the same wording. Translation was compared with adjacent Hebrew but is not independently proofread; source history does not establish the translation method.
